notes.title: QUIJOTE: Quest for Glory Major Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Adventurers![/h1]

[b]QUIJOTE: Quest for Glory[/b] is being updated today with many new features. These new updates should make you play our game even better.

We have added a [b]New Level[/b] (The Knights Errant), UX/UI, text & cards improvements, new text for the armor, tutorial improvements (scenarios and combat), new card activation mechanics, character movement improvements (no wall trespassing) and sound effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123960/d6e369cda8f6c101cc537749488b7ca4d551532c.png[/img]

The new level is based on chapter 4 of the original book. Don Quixote meets the merchants of Toledo and he demands that the merchants must declare that Dulcinea is the most beautiful lady in the universe.

In [b]“The Knights Errant”[/b], punish the blasphemous knights who have not sworn to the beauty of Dulcinea. Stop them from leaving without getting their just desserts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123960/a37d3dda7a251ea7ee7b85146b91b53b067f7399.png[/img]

Share your feedback with us, and follow us on Twitter and Facebook.
Cheers!

Cubus Games.

notes.title: QUIJOTE: Quest for Glory
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2]

We are excited to announce that [b]Quijote: Quest for Glory[/b], a tactical card strategy game, will be available on Steam Early Access on March 31.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123960/8707255f50a90d3874750155f3d0fb5c01a0f110.png[/img]
[b]Quijote: Quest for Glory[/b] is an interactive tactical card game based on a  journey through the most significant episodes of the work of Cervantes. 

The plot revolves around the adventures of Don Quixote's point of view: as a brave and powerful knight in search of eternal fame and glory.
